svg.title: PB600 Custom Control Model Overview
svg.desc: One-page infographic summarizing the implemented PB600 EdgeTX custom control model, major features, and UI panels.
svg.text: PB600 Custom Control Model
EdgeTX-based machine controller for the RadioMaster TX16S MK3 with custom Lua mixers, live tuning, safety interlocks, and dual UI panels.
3 MIXER SCRIPTS
18+ CHANNEL USES
5 LIVE TUNING GVS
2 PRIMARY UI PANELS
CONTROL FLOW
Inputs
sticks • sliders • switches
EdgeTX Model
mixes • channel routing • logical switches
Lua Control
system.lua • blade.lua • tiller.lua
Outputs + UI
actuators • sound • widgets • status
Track + Drive Control
• Differential left/right track drive from throttle + rudder
• Throttle-scaled rudder deadband and turn authority shaping
• Hydrostatic-style acceleration, braking, and reversal behavior
• Reverse blocked in Groom until implement clearance completes
• Engine/sound output follows effective track load, not raw stick
Blade Control
• 6 dedicated outputs: lift, tilt, angle, slew, LW, RW
• Automatic Transport ↔ Work positioning for lift, angle, wings
• Manual tilt/lift and slew/angle via SC mode switching
• Groom coordination adds rudder-based wing/slew/tilt/angle motion
• Reverse auto-lift captures and restores exact pre-reverse height
Tiller + Grooming Control
• Outputs for tiller angle, lift, finisher L/R, and swing
• Automatic Groom entry/exit positioning with timed finisher motion
• Manual tiller lift/angle on SC Down, finishers on SE / SG
• Coordinated swing and Groom-only tiller-angle assist
• Rotor safety interlock keeps tiller motor off during unsafe states
Safety, Modes, and State Management
• Three operating modes: Transport, Plow, Groom
• Independent E-stop handling in every mixer script
• Transition-state outputs expose blade/tiller automatic motion
• 5 global variables support live tuning without changing code
• Exact position models prevent drift across repeated cycles
• SH one-shot rehome resets modeled zero positions
• Logical switches drive local UI/audio status without owning safety
• Sound + light channels integrate with the same control model
UI Panels and Operator Feedback
PB600Op
Operator panel
Animated machine view, track motion, gauges,
status bar, light indicators, reverse/transition state.
PB600Dbg
Diagnostic panel
Inputs, switch states, logical switches, Lua outputs,
channels, and global variables for tuning + troubleshooting.
Top bar also includes PB600Version for app/version display loaded from /SCRIPTS/version.lua.
Summary source: README, models/model5.yml, scripts/mixes/*.lua, widgets/PB600Op, PB600Dbg, PB600Version.
